name: Echoes-of-Tarkov---Requisitions's Realism compatibility patch
teaser: A compatibility patch about realism mod and Echoes-of-Tarkov---Requisitions
description_html:
This is a compatibility patch

Used to solve the bug where Echoes-of-Tarkov—Requisitions’s weapons cannot run in the realism mod environment.

So you must have SPT-realism mod and Echoes-of-Tarkov—Requisitions first.

After testing, it can resolve the bug of echo mod’s weapon data not loading(the detail page shows a value error of 5/90) when Echoes-of-Tarkov—Requisitions load with SPT-realism mod

How to install

Download Echo-of-Tarkov realism-compatibility.zip

Drag and drop user folder into your SPT root

If have C:\root folder\user\mods\SPT-Realism\db\templates\user_templates\Echoes of Tarkov Requisitions: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ‘Templates’). Try placing the json files in the ‘‘weapons’’ folder （“user\mods\SPT-Realism\db\templates\weapons”)
